readings: For each film rating, count the number of rental transactions (linking each rental to its film through the inventory copy that was rented). Considering only the ratings whose count is above the average count across all ratings, return a single row with (1) the average count for those ratings and (2) the average amount by which their count exceeds that overall average, without rounding.
queries:
WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(rc.rental_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(rc.rental_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rc.rental_count > o.average_count
